items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Bichet was more than me and we was pals.

ctx.x: Who were the guys that you used to think were tough, say in the 20s, that would give you a good battle on the blues in the 20s and the 30s, around and then?

Well, the best man I could see was Johnny. Johnny who? Johnny who? Oh, did you overhear him play? Oh yeah, Johnny played here. We used to whip Johnny. Me and Bichet. You heard him play? Oh, I hope. Before he left here.
